## URLs Accessed for v3 Micro Outcome Data Collection
## Date: 2026-04-30
## Purpose: Goodhart Paper v3 — micro outcome data for reviewer response

### Target 1: 재정사업 자율평가 (Fiscal Project Self-Evaluation)

1. https://www.data.go.kr/data/15047853/fileData.do
   Status: Socket connection closed (unreachable from US WebFetch)
   Description: 기획재정부 소관별 재정사업 자율평가 보고서 정보

2. https://www.evaluation.go.kr/web/page.do?menu_id=125
   Status: Fetched — shows evaluation system description only, no data tables
   Content: System overview, grade distribution rules (우수 ≤20%, 보통 ~65%, 미흡 ≥15%)

3. https://www.evaluation.go.kr/web/summary.do?menu_id=83&eval_se_cd=2
   Status: Fetched — partial data for 2019 (data in PNG images, not extractable HTML)
   Content: 2019 summary: 1,189 total projects, 230 우수, 770 보통, 189 미흡
   Individual project rows visible as images not extractable text
   Sample projects extracted: 6 rows (2019 R&D category)

4. https://www.openfiscaldata.go.kr/op/ko/br/UOPKOBRA03
   Status: Fetched — dynamic JS page, table loads via AJAX (no static data)

5. https://www.mohw.go.kr/board.es?mid=a10107010202&bid=0037&act=list (보건복지부)
   Status: Fetched — shows 2016-2024 annual reports available as PDF/HWPX
   Files are PDF (binary compressed, not extractable by WebFetch)

6. https://www.mohw.go.kr/boardDownload.es?bid=0037&list_no=1483906&seq=1
   Status: Fetched — binary PDF (1MB), not text-extractable
   File: "22.(보건복지부)2023회계연도 재정사업 자율평가 결과_열린재정.pdf"

7. https://www.mpm.go.kr/board/file/bbs_0000000000000043/455/FILE_000000100006700/584f758bfe481d05c
   Status: Fetched — binary PDF (740KB), not text-extractable

### Data Coverage Limits:
- ALIO dataset: 2022-2024 partial (only prominently-reported institutions)
- Full 2024 grade list for public enterprises (공기업) appears complete at 63 rows
- Quasi-government agencies (준정부기관) 2024 partial: ~33/55 institutions captured
- 2023: only 13 institutions (prominently reported only)
- 2022: only 18 institutions (prominently reported only)
- Pre-2022: not captured (PDFs only, not accessible via WebFetch)
- 재정사업 자율평가: only 6 sample rows (2019 R&D); full data behind PDFs/dynamic JS
